_readme: Hand-written overrides for individual scene descriptions, keyed '<storyId>_<n>'. Used when the manifest's sentence-as-scene-prompt invites a bad interpretation (the model drawing a caption, book title, or multi-panel storyboard to represent an abstract action like 'shouted' or 'searched everywhere'). Only add entries here for scenes that were rejected on first generation.
l1.8s9_1: The child sits on a window seat reading a book, rain streaming down the window behind them, sky dark grey outside. The book is closed or held so its cover is not readable — a plain, blank-covered book, no title or lettering on it.
l1.8s9_2: The child stands at the window pointing excitedly at a huge rainbow outside, mouth open in delight, one single joyful expression — no speech bubble, caption, or any text anywhere in the frame. Mum is just arriving in the doorway behind them, smiling.
l1.8s1_1: The child stands by the front door in their coat and boots, holding up a single glove and looking around with a puzzled expression, the other hand empty. No basket, box, or labelled container anywhere in the scene.
l1.8s1_2: The child kneels on the floor peering under a bed, one single moment of searching in one single location — not a montage or multiple search spots in the same frame. Toys are visible under the bed but no glove.
l1.10s5_1: A busy school summer fair in a playground on a bright July day. Colourful triangular bunting is strung between poles. Around the playground are simple game stalls with striped awnings, a table laid with cakes on a patterned cloth, a face-painting corner, and cheerful families and children of many backgrounds walking about. Priya (matching her character guide) and her mum arrive and look around happily. IMPORTANT: every stall banner, awning, sign, poster and label must be completely blank — absolutely no words, letters, numbers or captions anywhere in the frame.
l1.10s5_2: A hook-a-duck game stall at a school summer fair. A round blue paddling pool holds several yellow plastic ducks floating on the water. Priya (matching her character guide) leans over the pool, smiling in concentration, holding a small wooden fishing rod with a string and hook, about to hook a duck. A friendly parent volunteer stands behind a small stall table with a few plain wrapped prizes. Bunting and blurred fair stalls fill the background. IMPORTANT: the stall's hanging banner and every sign, label and price must be completely blank — absolutely no words, letters or numbers anywhere in the frame.
l1.10s5_3: Priya (matching her character guide) stands beaming at a school summer fair, proudly holding up her prize: a plain box of colouring pencils and a plain sketch pad, both with completely blank covers. Her mum stands beside her smiling proudly. The blue hook-a-duck paddling pool with yellow ducks is just behind them, with bunting and fair stalls softly blurred in the background. IMPORTANT: every box, pad, banner, sign and label must be blank — absolutely no words, letters, numbers or brand names anywhere in the frame.
l1.10s7_3: A school hall rehearsal for the class play. Ollie (matching his character guide) stands on a low wooden stage wearing a simple, plain school-play costume over his own clothes, gesturing as he practises his lines with growing confidence. His teacher, a kind woman in her thirties, sits on a chair just in front of the stage watching and encouraging him. A couple of classmates sit on a bench at the side of the stage. A plainly painted castle backdrop and a red stage curtain are behind him. IMPORTANT: every backdrop, banner, poster and sign must be completely blank — absolutely no words, letters, numbers, play title or character name anywhere in the frame.
